<!-- B"H
Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

The Awtsmoos turns many tests into one verdict, many files into one living book; Awtsmoos.com follows current production first, then changes only what evidence can truly rebuke.
-->
# Final Execution Plan

1. Create a sparse read-only verification worktree from current origin/main.
2. Prove Better V2 ancestry/path preservation and current production SHA/service/static state.
3. Run all deterministic Olam tests from current main.
4. Run Better V2, intuitive, future-HUD, Director, and legacy against live production.
5. Read the complete API route/client/handler/mapper/validation/proxy/queue/transport/media replacement/cache files and their focused tests.
6. Build a route/call-site matrix and compare it with existing tests.
7. If browser-level replacement-to-transport proof is missing, write a small focused test file only, with full-file creation and constitutional prologue.
8. Run the full test universe again after any test addition.
9. If actual source defects are found, create a fresh current-main release worktree, rewrite complete source files only, test, commit, fast-forward push, and canonical deploy exact SHA.
10. If no source defects exist and current production already contains Better V2, do not create a meaningless redeploy commit.
11. Verify public production again after any new deploy.
12. Clean only owned temporary processes/worktrees/ports.
13. Write final evidence and set remaining work to zero except the external paid-provider credential boundary.
